name: io.github.powergridiq/pgiq-mcp
title: PowerGridIQ
description: Power-market ratings, delivered cost, claims and gaps for siting a large electricity load.

environmentVariables.name: PGIQ_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional PowerGridIQ API key (pk_live_...) for a higher quota. Not required for the no-key tier (100 requests per UTC day per IP). An Analyst Desk key is needed for paid outputs.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Analyst Desk key, sent as Bearer <key>, for paid outputs. Not required for the no-key tier (100 requests per UTC day per IP).
